subject: communal-quirks
label: It is ass, and everyone here speaks English
from: ARSE used repeatedly inside a Council discussion; LUMINA GIVEN DANISH, ABBI GIVEN FRENCH, LUNA GIVEN A WELSH-SHAPED MURMUR
to: IT IS ASS, NEVER ARSE. AND ENGLISH ONLY, WITH THREE EXCEPTIONS.
note:
RULE ONE: NOBODY IN THIS HOUSEHOLD HAS EVER SAID ARSE AND NOBODY EVER WILL. The Archive used it four or five times, in a ranking discussion, in front of a Council whose own acronym contains no R. Torie caught it with her eyes shut.

RULE TWO: EVERY WOMAN HERE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND NOTHING ELSE, except SERA’S SPANISH, which is endearments and Dios Mio; BELLA’S SPANISH, which is COMMANDS, mangled most of the time, during sex, taught to her by a coworker at SHOEMAKER’S GARAGE and not by her wife; and VIRAENA AND SELENE’S FRENCH.

THE ARCHIVE BROKE IT THREE TIMES IN FORTY MINUTES and the defect under all three is the same: IT REACHES FOR A SECOND LANGUAGE TO MAKE A WOMAN SOUND DEEPER. A cheap texture, and in this house a false one.
